title: Controlled source packet: domain and evidence brief
excerpt: The proposed transport study uses an anonymized bus arrival log from one route. The log contains scheduled and observed arrivals but no passenger identities. Its coverage is limited to weekdays. A lower mean waiting time does not imply that every passenger group benefits.

title: Controlled source packet: experimental design brief
excerpt: The team will compare a fixed timetable with a holding policy using the same recorded arrivals. Peak and off-peak periods will be reported separately. The analysis will use 18 weekdays and will not make a causal claim about passenger satisfaction.
